text: The V-shaped picture links needs and detailed designs to later integration of the built parts. Construction belongs near the bottom. Verification checks specified requirements. Validation checks whether the result meets its intended purpose in real use. These are related but different judgments.

items: Illustration: A communication device meets its laboratory range target, while the crew still cannot exchange the information it needs. That test result does not settle mission suitability.

text: Definition and design lead to implementation, then checking and intended-use evaluation.
For each important design decision, identify what evidence will demonstrate the relevant outcome.
Passing a technical test does not prove the intended mission succeeds.
